title: Really works
text: Really works. I love that they fit on any size bottle! Very easy to use. Just replace this instead of the bottle cap....pump it a few times until the bottle gets hard. You will hear that hiss when you open it.

product_metadata.title: Air Lock Soda Sealer – FRESHeTECH Portable Handheld Carbonation Keeper – 5 Caps
features: KEEP DRINKS FIZZY – Keep sparkling water sparkling and bubbly drinks bubbly with this patented air pressure technology which maintains CO2 levels inside the bottle and preserving carbonation.
FOR ALL BOTTLES – Each stopper in this set works on any plastic soda bottle, from the 12 oz to the 20 oz to the 1 liter and even the 2 liter bottles.
DISHWASHER SAFE – These five reusable caps are each dishwasher safe and, once they cover your carbonated beverage, are sure to keep soda fresh and fizzy for weeks after opening.
EASY TO USE – Once opened, replace the old soda lid with a soda sealer and press down by pumping. 8 to 20 pumps are usually enough.
SMART TOP – Turn the dial on the built-in calendar to the date it was opened so you know which one to drink next.
